scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --watch server.js --ext js,ts,json --exec "npm run build && node dist/server.js"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:bootstrap && vitest run --configLoader native
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run test:bootstrap && vitest run --configLoader native tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run --configLoader native tests/integration
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build && vitest run --configLoader native tests/contracts
scripts.test:bff: npm run build && vitest run --configLoader native --config vitest.bff.config.mjs
